citations.quote: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them.

row.answer: Udyr is a stance-switching fighter and tank who uses empowered attacks and can recast a stance to Awaken it. He combines movement speed and attack-based stuns with shielding, healing, physical attack damage and magic storm damage; his damage scales with AD and AP.

citations.quote: After casting any of his abilities, Udyr's next two basic attacks gain attack speed and reduce Awakened Spirit's cooldown.

claims.claim: After casting an ability, his next two basic attacks gain attack speed and reduce Awaken's cooldown.

row.answer: Udyr has no ultimate ability: his abilities grant stances, and he can periodically recast a stance to Awaken it for an additional effect. After casting an ability, his next two basic attacks gain attack speed and reduce Awaken's cooldown.

citations.quote: Claw Stance: Udyr first two basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to a portion of the target's maximum health. Additionally, he gains attack speed and bonus on-hit physical damage for a few seconds.

claims.claim: Wilding Claw grants attack speed and empowers his next two basic attacks with physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

citations.quote: Awaken: The next two basic attacks release a chain of lighting that bounces to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage equal to a portion of their maximum health and can bounce to the same enemy multiple times for a lack of targets. Additionally, he gains even greater attack speed for a few seconds.

claims.claim: Awaken grants more attack speed and adds maximum-health magic lightning to his next two basic attacks; the lightning chains between nearby enemies and can hit the same enemy repeatedly when other targets are lacking.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: His empowered attacks threaten substantial damage against isolated targets.

row.answer: Wilding Claw grants attack speed and empowers his next two basic attacks with physical damage based on the target's maximum health.
